# dopeIPTV

> dopeIPTV is a free, open-source desktop IPTV player for Xtream Codes, M3U playlists and Stalker / Ministra portals, and for the receivers, TV servers and media servers at home (Enigma2, Tvheadend, HDHomeRun, SAT>IP, Jellyfin, Emby, Plex and more). It has a full EPG (XMLTV) guide, pause and rewind on every live channel, catch-up TV, one-click recording, and multiview for up to nine channels at once — all in one native app built on the mpv engine. It is made for Linux and also runs on macOS and Windows.

Key facts:

- **What it is:** a desktop IPTV *player* (client), not an IPTV provider. It does not supply, sell or host any channels or content — the user connects their own Xtream Codes, M3U or Stalker portal provider, or their own receiver or media server.
- **Licence & price:** free and open source under GPL-3.0. No ads, no tracking, no accounts.
- **Platforms:** Linux (primary; AppImage and .deb for x86_64 and ARM64, Flatpak for x86_64, and the AUR package `dopeiptv` on Arch Linux), macOS (.dmg, Apple Silicon and Intel), Windows (installer with self-update, and a portable build; x64 and ARM64).
- **Sources:** Xtream Codes (server + username + password), M3U / M3U8 URLs and Stalker / Ministra portals (portal URL + MAC address; experimental); Enigma2 receivers, Tvheadend, HDHomeRun, SAT>IP servers, VDR, DVBViewer, NextPVR and MythTV; Jellyfin, Emby and Plex with their films, series, resume points and watched marks; local video and music files, internet radio, and YouTube or Twitch through yt-dlp. Multiple sources side by side, their live channels in one list (Every source), one search across all of them, and free demo channels to try it without an account.
- **Guide & timeshift:** full XMLTV EPG with now/next that keeps itself up to date; pause and rewind any live channel (minutes in memory, up to 6 hours on disk, or with dopeIPTV's own buffer, which keeps downloading while paused — experimental); catch-up into a provider's archive.
- **Recording:** record the watched stream over a single connection, with timers, size limits and a Recordings library; with dopeIPTV's own buffer, recordings come from the buffer and stay whole while paused.
- **Mine, TV, Movies and Series:** the places in the sidebar, opening where you left off. Mine holds continue watching, favourite channels live now in the order you usually watch them, favourite films and series, Watch later, new episodes of followed series and History by day; Movies and Series show this week's popular titles the provider has (TMDB's weekly chart) and Continue; every series has a page of its own.
- **Downloads and offline:** download films and episodes to watch without the network - one at a time, at a calm pace that looks like watching to the provider; with no network the app goes into offline mode by itself, shows only what is downloaded and sends nothing to the internet.
- **Multiview:** watch up to nine live channels at once in a grid, with per-window timeshift and subtitles.
- **Extras:** built-in mpv player; casting to Chromecast, DLNA/UPnP smart TVs and Kodi, and to an Apple TV through AirPlay on macOS; a profile for each person in the household, with kids profiles; TV mode for the sofa and the phone as a remote; dopeIPTV as the home's server (an HDHomeRun tuner for Plex, Jellyfin and Emby); watching together in step; encrypted settings sync between computers; subtitles from OpenSubtitles.com; the desktop's media controls and media keys on Linux, macOS and Windows; new-episode alerts for followed series; Trakt and Simkl watched-history sync; TMDB metadata and artwork, 25 themes (dark, light, and some with a colour of their own) with accent colours, test builds for early adopters, full keyboard control, and an interface available in 26 languages besides English (with right-to-left support for Arabic, Hebrew, Persian and Urdu).
- **Developer / owner:** the slimture/dopeIPTV project on GitHub.

## Main pages

- [Home / overview](https://dopeiptv.org/): features, screenshots and downloads.
- [Features](https://dopeiptv.org/#features): EPG, timeshift & catch-up, pause live TV, recording, multiview, multi-provider, playback, local files, casting to TVs, subtitles, media keys, following a series.
- [Download](https://dopeiptv.org/#download): latest builds for Linux, macOS and Windows, generated from the GitHub releases.
- [About dopeIPTV](https://dopeiptv.org/help/#about): short answers to common questions - what it is, whether it is free, where channels come from, systems and languages.
- [Troubleshooting](https://dopeiptv.org/help/#fix): common problems and how to fix them (sign-in, expired subscription, connection limit, another device on the account, VPN blocks, devices not found on a home network split into VLANs).
- [Help](https://dopeiptv.org/help/): setup (Xtream, M3U, Stalker portals and their catch-up, VDR, DVBViewer, NextPVR and MythTV servers, SAT>IP servers and a Fritz!Box Cable, Jellyfin, Emby and Plex), playback, a series' page with its seasons, teletext and DVB subtitles, night mode, the visualiser for music and radio channels, the command palette, viewing statistics, YouTube and Twitch, TV mode and the phone remote, rewinding live TV, the guide, timeshift, recording, multiview, casting (and an Apple TV), dopeIPTV as the home's server (an HDHomeRun tuner for Plex, Jellyfin and Emby, a playlist for VLC and Kodi, also without a window on a NAS or a Raspberry Pi), watching together, internet radio, Trakt and Simkl, profiles, settings sync (and bringing settings to a new computer), an Enigma2 box's channel lists, Mine, the support heart, test builds and troubleshooting.
- [Privacy policy](https://dopeiptv.org/privacy/): what the app, the website and its services process (no analytics in the app; cookieless site statistics), for how long, and GDPR rights.
- [Terms of use](https://dopeiptv.org/terms/): dopeIPTV is a player only and provides no channels or content; the GPL licence; the user's responsibility for the services they add.
- [Support dopeIPTV](https://dopeiptv.org/support/): a tip for the app - any amount, never a subscription, nothing given for it.
- [Payment terms](https://dopeiptv.org/payments/): tips, how they are paid and refunds.
- [About us and contact](https://dopeiptv.org/about/): made by Solecraft AB, Sweden; company details and contact.

## Source & documentation

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/slimture/dopeIPTV): source code, issues and releases.
- [Releases](https://github.com/slimture/dopeIPTV/releases): all downloadable builds and changelogs.
- [AUR package](https://aur.archlinux.org/packages/dopeiptv): `dopeiptv` for Arch Linux, installed with an AUR helper such as yay.
- [Readme / docs](https://github.com/slimture/dopeIPTV#readme): documentation and setup.
- [Licence (GPL-3.0)](https://github.com/slimture/dopeIPTV/blob/main/LICENSE): licence text.

## Credits (third-party projects)

- Playback: [mpv](https://mpv.io) and [FFmpeg](https://ffmpeg.org).
- Interface: Qt and [PyQt6](https://www.riverbankcomputing.com/software/pyqt/).
- Casting: [PyChromecast](https://github.com/home-assistant-libs/pychromecast) (Google Cast); DLNA/UPnP TVs with the Python standard library.
- Subtitles: [OpenSubtitles.com](https://www.opensubtitles.com) REST API.
- Metadata & artwork: [The Movie Database (TMDB)](https://www.themoviedb.org).
- Watched sync: [Trakt](https://trakt.tv).
